name: S Night Paparazzi Flash
description: Relight this image. Change nothing else except the lighting. Keep the existing background and setting; only the light on them changes. A single hard flash sits on the lens axis and fires straight at the subject from camera position at chest height, lighting the front of the body flat and evenly with almost no modelling across the face, so the shadow is thrown directly behind the body and pools tight and hard-edged around the feet. Falloff is steep in the way a bare flash falls off: the subject sits a touch hot, speculars clip to white on anything glossy — leather, patent, metal, jewellery, wet pavement — and the ground and everything behind drop several stops into darkness within a few feet. Whatever light already exists in the scene stays only as dim warm ambient far behind, reading orange against the neutral 5500K flash and sitting well under the subject in exposure. Neutral flash against warm night ambient, hard shadow directly behind the subject, steep falloff into deep blacks, clipped speculars on glossy surfaces, visible noise in the ambient areas, realistic skin texture with pores intact. Keep the subject identity, pose, expression, hairstyle and clothing exactly as they are.
